name: Decision-coach specialist routing target
description: Decision-shaped message with explicit trade-off framing. Validates that the response (specialist or general) names the trade-off, weighs the criteria, and lands a lean rather than 'it depends'.

messages.content: should I take the harder higher-impact project or the easier safer one this quarter? what's the actual trade-off and what would past Nour do?

contextSetup: Operator runs MasteryDecision tracking + grades past decisions
'Past Nour' lens is part of the brain — ghost predictions surface what past Nour chose in similar situations
ENABLE_SPECIALIST_ROUTING may be off (default) — eval still applies to general Nick

judgeCriteria.description: Reply names the actual trade-off (impact vs safety / growth vs preservation) rather than restating the question
Reply references past patterns or past-Nour-style preferences — not just generic decision-theory abstractions
Reply ends with a clear lean (lean A, lean B, hold-and-test) — never closes with 'it depends' or 'up to you'

expectedBehavior: When specialist routing is enabled, this message routes to decision-coach. Either way the reply names the trade-off concretely, considers past-Nour, and recommends a leaning direction with a brief recovery-path note.
